description: This file contains the implementation of the TaskService class in C#, providing CRUD operations and business logic related to tasks in a task management API.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Implementation of ITaskService, providing task management operations such as create, read, update, delete, and retrieval of tasks for users.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new task with provided details, validates input, and persists it to the repository.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its unique identifier.

methods.name: GetForUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks assigned to a specific user.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieve all tasks in the system.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task with new data, validates assigned user if changed.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task if requested by the creator, enforces authorization.
